intent: Go through every IP address tagged onb-audit, ten to a page: open each one, set its description to the audit note, save, and return to the list; then the next page.

verify_yaml.first:
schema_version: openadapt.verify/v1
app:
  name: NetBox (local test copy)
  url: http://127.0.0.1:9486/ipam/ip-addresses/?tag=onb-audit&per_page=10&ordering=address
  version: netbox@4.1.11
  session: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:open_session
  reset:
    python: benchmark.onboarding_effort.hooks:reset
verifier:
  kind: sql
  sql_driver: pg8000.dbapi
  sql_connect_args: {host: 127.0.0.1, port: 9489, user: nb_reader, database: netbox}
  sql_password_env: NB_READER_PASSWORD
  sql_query: "SELECT host(address) AS host, description FROM ipam_ipaddress"
effects:
  - kind: field_equals
    match: {host: {param: host}}
    field: description
    value: {param: description}
save_step: auto
inputs:
  source: recorded
campaign:
  id: onboarding-nb-ip-paginated-first
  trials: 3
  policy: permissive
